## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-3 is asserted but expressly left unproved. Claims 1–2 do not by themselves establish the required congruence in \(Q\).
- claim-4 verifies only \((i,j,a,b)=(2,3,2,2)\); finite evidence cannot establish the formula for every \(\rho\subseteq b^a\).
- The admissibility checks ensuring both indexed shapes lie in \(q^r\) are omitted, including use of \(b\le i,j\), \(a+j\le r\), and \(a+i\le q\).
- The draft’s proposed congruence (1), which would imply the certificate, is neither derived nor disproved.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] For all admissible \(r,q,i,j,a,b\) and every padded partition \(\rho\subseteq b^a\), prove or disprove
  \[
  [\bar s_{(i^j,\rho)}]
  =(-1)^{|\rho|}
  [\bar s_{(i+\rho'_1,\ldots,i+\rho'_b,i^{j-b})}]
  \quad\text{in }J_v/A_+J_v,
  \]
  including the shape-in-\(q^r\) checks and the cases \(\rho=\varnothing\) and \(a=0\).
